items.problem: `prepare` is `false` with no log for a tween preset with a negative repeat count. `_load_preset` returns `_cycle_ms(definition) * definition.repeat_count`, so a preset with one 100 ms change and `repeat_count = -1` gives -100. `client/godot/core/message_core/message_core.gd:393` reads every negative length as "already logged" and returns `false`, but on this path neither `MessageCore` nor `ResourceCore.load` writes a log, because the repeat count check of `TweenCore` (`client/godot/core/tween_core/tween_core.gd:875`) runs only at playback. The `prepare` failure conditions of `open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/message-core.md` (`## error`, first row) are a preset that cannot be loaded or repeats infinitely, and each has a log. A negative change delay or duration reaches the same path. A boot that uses such a preset fails in the `Prepare` stage with no cause in the log.

`release` during a `prepare` in progress has no test. `open-game-works-core/skills/core/SKILL.md:90` says that `release` stops the async operations in progress and that a stopped operation returns a failure value. No test under `client/godot/core/message_core/tests/` calls `MessageCore.release` while a `prepare` waits: the calls at `test_lifecycle.gd:10`, `test_lifecycle.gd:23`, `test_lifecycle.gd:70` and `test_input.gd:84` all run with no `prepare` pending. Removing the session checks at `message_core.gd:114`, `message_core.gd:379`, `message_core.gd:384`, `message_core.gd:422` or `message_core.gd:448` is not exercised by any assert, although without them the resumed `_load_all` reads `_toast` after `_reset_state` set it to `null`.

"The wording appears in the center of the visible game area" (`open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/message-core.md`, `### resource`) has no test for the toast made by code. `client/godot/core/message_core/tests/test_view.gd:47` checks the center only for the label of the black box, and `test_view.gd:61` reads only the band's style. Changing `band.anchor_top` and `band.anchor_bottom` at this position to 0 is not exercised by any assert, so the toast made by code could leave the center with every test passing.
